name: website-audit
title: Website Audit
description: Evidence-based audit of layout, UX, responsiveness, performance, accessibility, SEO, technical problems, content quality and conversion.
when_to_use: Before redesigning, before launch, or when asked to review a site.
instructions: Every finding cites evidence: tool output, a file/selector, a viewport or a screenshot.
Cover layout, UX, responsiveness, performance, accessibility, SEO, technical defects, content quality and conversion problems.
Prioritise: critical (blocks users or launch), major (clearly hurts outcomes), minor (polish).
Every issue has a concrete fix.
